footer.tagline: Your place on earth, where time moves a little slower.

hero.title: Holiday cottage in Masuria
hero.subtitle: A hot tub under the stars. The rolling landscape of the Masurian Hills, three nearby lakes and the scent of the forest. Make yourself at home at Domek na Mazurskiej :)

intro.description: Looking for a proper reset? Welcome to Stare Juchy near Ełk! Our welcoming holiday cottage offers wide-open space beside a Natura 2000 forest, with lovely views of a pond and meadows. A lake with a peaceful, secluded forest beach is just 500 metres away.
intro.invitation: A romantic getaway for two, time with family, a trip with friends, or a quiet solo break by the forest – unwind in the true spirit of Masuria.

amenities.title: Comforts and activities on your doorstep
amenities.subtitle: We have thought about the space and facilities so you have everything you need. From relaxing in the hot tub to water sports and a well-equipped kitchen, it is all here for your comfort.
amenities.forest: Natura 2000 forest, pond and meadow views
amenities.lake: 500 m to a forest lake & water sports
amenities.family: Playground, football goal & a dog-friendly stay
amenities.jacuzziDesc: Enjoy a private soak in the bubbles under the open sky. Perfect for cooler evenings, unwinding after a walk and watching the stars.
amenities.forestDesc: The cottage stands right beside the forest. Large windows and the mezzanine overlook a pond, meadows and the rolling Masurian Hills. With no fences, the surrounding space stays open and natural.
amenities.lakeDesc: A short walk through the forest takes you to a peaceful, secluded beach. Three lakes are nearby: Jędzelewo, Garbas and Rekąty. SUP boards and a small rowing boat are available on site by prior arrangement.
amenities.terraceDesc: Gather around the campfire for an evening of roasting sausages and conversation by the crackling flames, or enjoy morning coffee and lazy afternoons on a lounger on the spacious terrace.
amenities.familyDesc: Children can enjoy a playground, trampoline and football goal on the grass. Your dog is very welcome too – the open space around the cottage is a wonderful place to run and play!
amenities.locationDesc: Close to nature, with everyday essentials nearby. The centre of Stare Juchy and the Dino supermarket are both 1.3 km from the cottage, an approximately 18-minute walk. A viewing tower is nearby, and free parking is available right by the property.

interior.title: Bright, welcoming interiors with beautiful views
interior.desc: We designed Domek na Mazurskiej to be a place where you simply feel at ease. Large living-room windows look out over a pond, meadows and the edge of the forest, so you stay close to nature even while relaxing on the sofa.
interior.layout: Inside, you will find a bright, spacious living room for evenings together, a fully equipped kitchenette for preparing meals, a cosy bedroom and an upstairs mezzanine with even lovelier views.

house.title: About Domek na Mazurskiej – Discover the interiors and surroundings
house.desc: Our year-round cottage in Stare Juchy was designed for comfort and closeness to nature. Large living-room windows fill the space with light and open up beautiful views of a pond, meadows and the edge of a Natura 2000 forest. It is an ideal place for a quiet break, a family holiday or time away with friends.

outdoor.subtitle: Your surroundings and private relaxation
outdoor.imageAlt: Terrace with a hot tub and meadow views at Domek na Mazurskiej
outdoor.jacuzziDesc: Your own relaxation space under the open sky, perfect for unwinding in the evening.
outdoor.terraceDesc: Comfortable outdoor furniture and loungers with direct views of a pond, meadows and the edge of the forest.
outdoor.firepitDesc: A dedicated spot for evening campfires and a gas barbecue on the property, with firewood available on site.
outdoor.parkingDesc: Free parking spaces right by the cottage.

family.subtitle: Recreation for children and adults

family.waterDesc: SUP boards and a small rowing boat are available on site by prior arrangement.
family.babyDesc: A cot and high chair are available on request.

indoor.title: Comfort indoors
indoor.imageAlt: Living room and the view from the mezzanine at Domek na Mazurskiej
indoor.bedroomDesc: A cosy, enclosed room with a double bed and underfloor heating.
indoor.loftDesc: An upstairs space with a double bed and lovely views over the pond and surrounding meadows.
indoor.sofaDesc: An open living area with a comfortable double sofa bed, providing an additional sleeping space for two.
indoor.kitchenDesc: A dishwasher, drip coffee maker, induction hob, fridge-freezer, kettle, and a full set of pots, crockery and cutlery.

attractions.title: Nearby attractions – what to see around Domek na Mazurskiej
attractions.intro: Our cottage is a great base for exploring. Enjoy the peace of a neighbouring Natura 2000 forest, with lovely spots, beaches and viewpoints close by.

pond.title: Panorama of the Masurian hills
pond.desc: Rolling countryside towards the village of Liski, with a private pond in the distance — the view that comes with your morning coffee on the terrace.

beach.title: A quiet forest beach – 500 m from the cottage
beach.desc: A short, 10-minute walk through the forest takes you to a secluded beach. A peaceful place for a swim and time by the water, away from the crowds.

sandHill.title: Sand Hill beside Jędzelewo Lake
sandHill.desc: An unusual sandy hill right beside the lake, with a desert-like landscape. A lovely viewpoint over Stare Juchy and Jędzelewo Lake.

lakes.title: Three lakes, fishing and a rowing boat
lakes.desc: Lakes Jędzelewo, Garbas and Rekąty are nearby. A small rowing boat for early-morning fishing and a SUP board are available on site by prior arrangement.

forest.title: Natura 2000 forest paths
forest.desc: With the forest right next door, head out for walks, a morning jog or an outing with your dog. In autumn, enjoy mushroom picking and the quiet of nature.
forest.imageAlt: The cottage surroundings beside forest and meadows

tower.title: Viewing tower in Stare Juchy
tower.desc: Take a short trip to a viewpoint overlooking local forests, lakes and the rolling Masurian Hills.

bike.title: Cycling routes in the Masurian Hills
bike.desc: Scenic gravel roads, gentle climbs and wide-open views over fields make this a wonderful area to explore on two wheels.

elk.title: A day out in Ełk (around 20 km)
elk.desc: A lively promenade with restaurants beside Ełk Lake, a historic narrow-gauge railway and a rope park offer a change of pace during your stay.
elk.imageAlt: Panorama of Ełk beside Ełk Lake

village.title: Stare Juchy and everyday essentials
village.desc: The centre of Stare Juchy and the Dino supermarket are 1.3 km (approximately 18 minutes on foot) from the cottage. The village has shops, essential services, a railway station and a bus stop. Seasonal events include local festivals and the well-known Piknik Jaćwieski.

gizycko.title: Giżycko – harbours and sailing (32 km)
gizycko.desc: Around 30 minutes by car takes you to the sailing capital of Masuria. Explore lively harbours and marinas, take a boat cruise or visit Boyen Fortress.
gizycko.imageAlt: Harbour and lakeside panorama of Giżycko

food.title: Local food – home cooking and fresh fish
food.desc: Gościniec Na Wzgórzu (800 m, a 10-minute walk) serves home-cooked meals in season. The fish restaurant by the beach in Liski (1.5 km) is another favourite. We have tried them ourselves and recommend them!

directions.title: How to get to Domek na Mazurskiej 31G in Stare Juchy
directions.intro: Our cottage is tucked away in a quiet spot right beside the forest. Follow these directions for a stress-free journey, whether you are coming by car, train or bus.
directions.turn: Leave the main asphalt road by the Therapy Centre (Ośrodek Terapii) in Stare Juchy and follow the charming Masurian country road.
directions.forest: Continue straight along Mazurska Street, pass number 31, then turn left just before the forest.
directions.parking: Free private parking awaits you on the property.
directions.train: The station is 2.2 km from the cottage — around a 30-minute walk. Trains to Stare Juchy run from places including Ełk, Olsztyn and Białystok.
directions.bus: The bus stop is 1.6 km from the cottage, in the village centre at Plac 500-lecia.
